internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:33 UTC, a high latency alert was triggered for the ad service. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion caused by very high CPU utilization (98%) coinciding with the activation of the 'adHighCpu' feature flag. This led to increased error rates and latency degradation. The mitigation involved disabling the 'adHighCpu' flag at 12:52 UTC, which resulted in verified recovery with latency metrics returning to normal levels.

Additional latency was observed in the frontend and checkout services but was less severe and likely secondary to the ad service issue.

Timeline:
- 12:33: Alert received
- 12:52: Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion in ad service
- 12:52: Proposed and approved disabling of 'adHighCpu' flag
- 12:52: Flag disabled and recovery verified

Severity: SEV2

external.title: Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 12:33 and 12:53 UTC on 2026-11-08, customers experienced increased latency in our advertising service. The issue was caused by resource exhaustion leading to slower response times. Our team identified the cause and implemented a fix by disabling a feature that was causing high CPU usage. The service latency has returned to normal, and the issue is resolved. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
